description: SQL/PGQ query examples for DuckDB CPG - used for few-shot learning in RAG

examples.question: What methods does main call?
examples.sql: SELECT DISTINCT callee.name AS method_name, callee.full_name, callee.filename, callee.line_number FROM edges_call ec JOIN nodes_call c ON ec.src = c.id JOIN nodes_method caller ON c.containing_method_id = caller.id JOIN nodes_method callee ON ec.dst = callee.id WHERE caller.name = 'main' LIMIT 100;

examples.question: Show call chain from main with depth 3
examples.sql: WITH RECURSIVE call_chain AS (SELECT ec.src, ec.dst, 1 as depth FROM edges_call ec JOIN nodes_call c ON ec.src = c.id JOIN nodes_method m_start ON c.containing_method_id = m_start.id WHERE m_start.name = 'main' UNION ALL SELECT ec2.src, ec2.dst, cc.depth + 1 FROM edges_call ec2 JOIN call_chain cc ON ec2.src IN (SELECT c2.id FROM nodes_call c2 WHERE c2.containing_method_id = cc.dst) WHERE cc.depth < 3) SELECT DISTINCT m.name, m.full_name, m.filename, m.line_number, MIN(cc.depth) as depth FROM call_chain cc JOIN nodes_method m ON cc.dst = m.id GROUP BY m.id, m.name, m.full_name, m.filename, m.line_number ORDER BY depth, m.name LIMIT 100;

examples.question: Trace execution path from exec_simple_query depth 5

examples.question: Trace data flow for variable userInput
examples.sql: WITH RECURSIVE data_flow AS (SELECT src, dst, variable, 1 as hops FROM edges_reaching_def WHERE variable = 'userInput' UNION ALL SELECT erd.src, erd.dst, erd.variable, df.hops + 1 FROM edges_reaching_def erd JOIN data_flow df ON erd.src = df.dst WHERE df.hops < 5 AND erd.variable = 'userInput') SELECT DISTINCT src, dst, variable, hops FROM data_flow ORDER BY hops LIMIT 100;
